invariant: Each sequence group captures its merged root.element.sequenceDiagram.group style at construction. The style snapshot is owned by the group source epoch, so later declarations do not restyle an earlier group.

The frame dimensions, header dimensions, stroke, fill, text, note corner, and scaling already agree.
